limitations: This manifest maps repository mechanisms and tests; it does not assert that those tests passed in the current checkout.
Repository-static evidence is not deployment evidence, benchmark qualification, or industrial-readiness proof.
Line ranges identify the mapped implementation at this revision and must be reviewed when referenced files change.

capabilities.title: Module boundaries
capabilities.summary: Host adapters call an orchestration service that delegates authorization, retrieval, storage, sync, and operations to bounded modules.
limitations: MemplexService remains a large facade, and split modules retain compatibility re-exports and import-order constraints.

capabilities.title: Typed memory model
capabilities.summary: Function, Fact, Preference, and Observation share identity, provenance, visibility, version, and namespace fields through MemoryNode.
limitations: A typed model and serialization tests do not by themselves prove complete cross-backend persistence parity.

capabilities.title: Capture and write path
capabilities.summary: Ordinary capture reaches write(), which strips private blocks, extracts and authorizes Function, Fact, and Preference nodes, then persists typed nodes plus graph edges; Observation uses the separate authorized add_observation() path.
limitations: Development-only indexing and compaction tasks are best effort after the primary persistence path.

capabilities.title: Recall and retrieval path
capabilities.summary: Recall applies authorization, intent-selected retrieval paths, a shared candidate budget, merge and authorization filters, reranking, injection filtering, access accounting, top_k, and a final token budget.
limitations: Individual retrieval paths may fail independently and are recorded in an optional trace; repository mapping does not establish real-dataset recall quality.

capabilities.title: Bi-temporal facts
capabilities.summary: Facts retain business-time validity with valid_from and invalid_at while inherited timestamps record system time; superseded rows remain queryable with as_of.
limitations: The model distinguishes business and system timestamps but does not provide general temporal reasoning across arbitrary graph paths.

capabilities.title: Bounded graph expansion
capabilities.summary: Graph retrieval selects at most three seeds and spends the remaining top_k budget on bounded one-hop relation neighbors.
limitations: The implemented path is one-hop bounded expansion, not unrestricted traversal or general multi-hop reasoning.

capabilities.title: Principal and tenant authorization
capabilities.summary: Authenticated principal and workspace context are bound before persistence, and each service call derives a request-scoped store facade for tenant-aware access.
limitations: Lite storage is a single-user development backend and is not an operating-system adversary boundary; production isolation depends on PostgreSQL predicates and RLS configuration.

capabilities.title: Durable sync convergence
capabilities.summary: The durable protocol uses tenant-bound pages, atomic inbox/outbox state, cursors, leases, acknowledgements, retries, and dead letters behind one Lite/PostgreSQL repository contract.
limitations: The legacy SyncableStore transport is development-only best effort, can drop queued pushes at its hard cap, and is not equivalent to durable convergence.

capabilities.title: Backup and restore
capabilities.summary: Backup artifacts carry a canonical signed manifest and payload digest; verification pins the artifact before restore, with separate Lite and PostgreSQL restore surfaces.
limitations: Lite backup is development-only, and repository-static mapping does not prove a current PostgreSQL restore drill or recovery objective.

capabilities.title: Operations and observability
capabilities.summary: Runtime lifecycle, request admission, bounded low-cardinality metrics, drain results, alert-rule digests, and signed SLO evidence form the operations surface.
limitations: Signed-report machinery does not establish that a current deployment supplied the required observation window, load, drain, or report.

capabilities.title: Reproducible supply chain
capabilities.summary: The release builder fixes locale, hash seed, epoch, timezone, and offline inputs, normalizes archives, and emits checksums, an SBOM, and a canonical release manifest.
limitations: Deterministic builder code and tests do not prove that current public registry artifacts correspond to this checkout or that benchmark outputs are immutable.

capabilities.title: Four-host lifecycle
capabilities.summary: Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and Hermes share capture and recall semantics while host-specific install, status, uninstall, and contract digests remain explicit.
limitations: Repository tests and evidence schemas are not a current run on four real host installations; valid external lifecycle evidence remains separately required.
